hyperparameters.rule: contrastive coupled learning (free solve -> multiclass hinge clamp -> contrastive gate update)
hyperparameters.operating_point: inputs +-0.8 V, fixed gate init 2.0 V

network.device: NMOS, gate referenced to drain, body floating
network.structure: 34 inputs (scaled +-0.8 V) -> 5 hidden -> 2 outputs; 68 input->output + 68 input->hidden (uniform round-robin, label-independent) + 10 hidden->output + 1 output<->output lateral. Purely input-driven, no supply rail.

noise.note: per-device threshold-voltage mismatch (sigma=10 mV) and per-device drive-strength (kp) mismatch (sigma=0.5%), fixed per chip; free and clamp are electrically-separate device sets; plus a canonical Gaussian read-noise stream on every measurement (training and inference).
